title: PDU (Liebert/Vertiv RPC2)
description: Vertiv/Liebert rack PDU metrics from snmp_exporter's liebert_pdu module (LIEBERT-GP-PDU-MIB).

panels.title: Status
panels.description: lgpPduEntrySysStatus bit-field: 1 normal, 2 starting up, 8 warning, 16 alarm, 32 abnormal.

panels.title: Line Current
panels.description: Orange at 80% and red at 90% of the 16 A rated input current.

panels.title: Input Utilization
panels.description: Line current as a percentage of the PDU's rated input current.

panels.title: Energy (lifetime)
panels.description: Accumulated energy at the PDU input since installation or the last reset.

panels.title: Outlets On
panels.description: Outlets with power state on. lgpPduRcpEntryPwrState: 1 off, 2 on, 3 off pending on delay.

panels.title: Line Current
panels.description: Dashed lines are the warning/alarm thresholds configured on the PDU (percent of rated current) and the rated input current.

panels.title: Daily Energy
panels.description: Energy used per day at the PDU input. Each bar covers the 24h before it.

panels.title: Outlets
panels.description: Outlets are numbered as on the PDU (lgpPduRcpEntryIndex). Names are the outlet labels set in the PDU web UI. Power bar is scaled to 1200 W (10 A outlet at 120 V).
